column2: AutoGluon-TimeSeries Block A (Blk1.1): 17 fitting objectives x 6 forecast origins x 3 variables, h=1..12
All scores computed on the year-on-year inflation transform of the forecast index, against realised YoY
The 17 FITTING objectives (the eval_metric passed to the predictor). Codes are PAPER codes (EM1..EM17).
M1..Mk are forecast horizons in months. The final column is the window score used for ranking.
1-month, 3-month, 6-month and 12-month, as specified for the paper's ranking tables.
MASE and SQL are per-horizon, so the window score is the MEAN over M1..Mk. Soft-DTW and TPA are
cumulative path metrics, so the window score is the CUMULATIVE value at Mk -- it must not be averaged.
MASE, SQL, Soft-DTW: lower is better. TPA: higher is better.
Equal window scores are ordered by the mean over the full 12-month path, then by code. Ties are flagged.
The four assessment metrics are cited in the request by ARTIFACT codes (EM6 MASE, EM10 SQL, EM13 Soft-DTW,
EM18 TPA). In the renumbered paper table these are EM5, EM9, EM12 and EM17. Both are shown in each table header.
Rankings here are RAW. The eligibility screen of Section 3.9 is not applied; TDI and TPA collapse to a single
model in 100% of runs and TDA in 50-83%, so those rows would be excluded under that screen.
